text: きょうは　おにいさん　ポケモンとの　たたかいかたを　せつめい　しに　きたよー！

structure.jp: ポケモンとの　たたかいかたを
せつめい　しに　きたよー！

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.span: せつめい　しに　きた
patterns.explanation: A verb cut down to its stem plus に, before a verb of coming or going, says what you come or go to do. せつめい しに きた = 'came to explain'.

patterns.name: 〜かた
patterns.explanation: かた stuck on a verb stem means 'the way of doing it'. たたかいかた = 'how to battle'.
